name: Product Quantity Settings
author: JJ Montalban

sections.description:
This plugin create a new option in product data box of product edit page.
You can to set a minimum, a maximum one or a quantity range for products in Woocommerce. Customers can only buy in multiplications of your defined range.
sections.faq: This plugin works in cart page created by Woocommerce shortcode. Doesnt work in cart page created by blocks

short_description: Define a minimum / maximum / range quantity for products on product pages & cart.
description:
This plugin create a new option in product data box of product edit page.
You can to set a minimum, a maximum one or a quantity range for products in Woocommerce. Customers can only buy in multiplications of your defined range.

upgrade_notice: In first version customer could introduce random number of products

screenshots.caption: In the general tab of product creation, new options will appear to define the minimum quantity, the maximum quantity (-1 for infinity), and the range of quantities.
